text: Hi, really sorry to message so late. I'm a childminder and I've got a little girl overnight, she's 23 months. She's got a temp of 38.9 and I wanted to check how much paracetamol or ibuprofen I can give her and how often, as I don't want to get the dose wrong. She's absolutely fine in herself, wide awake, chattering away to her teddies and watching TV. Just so you know, her lips are a bit blue but that's from the blue raspberry ice lolly I gave her for her throat. Her tongue is the same colour and it's coming off on a wet wipe. Sorry again for bothering you.
